description: Ten new Roslyn-based commands: inline-method, safe-delete, replace-call, add-null-checks, make-sealed, convert-to-record, implement-interface, circular-deps, dependency-graph, add-test. Ordered read-only-last to build on mutation infrastructure.
ralph_instructions:
Work through userStories in priority order. For each story where passes=false: follow the TDD phase indicated in the story notes. Verification: `dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx` and `dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal` (use .sln for tests — MSBuildWorkspace does not support .slnx).

TDD DISCIPLINE:
- BASELINE: all tests green before any change
- RED: tests compile and fail for the right reason (NotImplementedException), NOT compilation errors
- GREEN: minimal code to pass — 100% line coverage on new code
- REFACTOR (required for every GREEN story): after tests pass, review the implementation. Check: (1) any duplication with existing commands that could be extracted into a shared helper; (2) naming consistency with the rest of the codebase; (3) no dead code. Tests must stay green, format must still pass.

File layout for each new command:
- src/RoslynTools/Commands/XxxCommand.cs — CLI definition, options, SetHandler
- src/RoslynTools/Core/XxxCore.cs (for larger commands) — Roslyn logic
- tests/RoslynTools.Tests/XxxTests.cs — xUnit tests with [Collection("MSBuild")]
- Register in src/RoslynTools/App.cs with alias

userStories.title: Write inline-method tests (RED)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests that define the inline-method command contract so the implementation is verifiable.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all existing tests green
Create tests/RoslynTools.Tests/InlineMethodTests.cs with [Collection("MSBuild")]
Use TestProjectBuilder with: class MathHelper { public int Double(int x) => x * 2; } and class Calc { void Run() { var a = MathHelper.Double(5); var b = MathHelper.Double(10); } }
Test: InlineMethod_SingleExpressionBody_ReplacedAtCallSite — both calls replaced with inlined expression (x * 2) with argument substituted
Test: InlineMethod_BlockBodySingleReturn_InlinedCorrectly — block-body method with single return statement inlined
Test: InlineMethod_MethodDeletedAfterInlining — source method declaration removed from class
Test: InlineMethod_MultipleCallSites_AllInlined — three call sites all replaced
Test: InlineMethod_DryRun_NoWrites — --dry-run shows diff but does not modify files
Create stub: src/RoslynTools/Commands/InlineMethodCommand.cs with Build() returning a Command that throws NotImplementedException
Register stub in src/RoslynTools/App.cs so it compiles
All tests COMPILE and RUN
InlineMethodTests FAIL on NotImplementedException — NOT on missing type or compilation error
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx succeeds
userStories.notes: Phase: RED. Scope: expression-bodied methods and block-bodied methods with a single return statement. No early returns, no out params. Stub must compile.

userStories.title: Implement inline-method command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want inline-method to replace all invocations of a simple method with its body and delete the method.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt inline-method --type <ClassName> --method <MethodName> [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]
Alias: im
Use SymbolLocator to find the method; error if not found or ambiguous
Supported methods: expression-bodied (`=> expr`) and block-bodied with exactly one return statement; error with clear message for anything else
For each call site: replace InvocationExpressionSyntax with the method body expression, substituting each parameter reference with the corresponding argument expression
After all call sites rewritten: remove the method declaration from the source class
--dry-run shows unified diff across all affected files; no writes
ALL InlineMethodTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Build a parameter-to-argument substitution map from the call site. Use CSharpSyntaxRewriter to replace IdentifierNameSyntax nodes matching parameter names within the inlined body. Collect all call-site spans BEFORE rewriting (stale-node pattern from MakeAsyncCommand). Use DocumentEditor to remove method after rewriting call sites.

userStories.title: Implement safe-delete command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to delete a type or method only if it has zero references.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt safe-delete --symbol <TypeOrMember> [--kind type|method|property] [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]
Alias: sd
Use SymbolLocator to find the symbol; error if not found
Use SymbolFinder.FindReferencesAsync to count references (same exclusions as find-unused: skip nameof, skip declarations)
If references exist: print each reference location to stdout, exit code 1
If zero references: remove the symbol's declaring syntax node via DocumentEditor
For types: remove entire class/interface/enum declaration
For methods/properties: remove the member declaration from its containing type
--dry-run shows unified diff; no writes

ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Reuse FindUnusedCore.AnalyzeAsync reference-counting logic. DocumentEditor.RemoveNode handles the deletion cleanly.

userStories.title: Implement replace-call command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to replace all invocations of one method with another, preserving arguments.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt replace-call --from <TypeName.MethodName> --to <MethodName> [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]

--from resolves to a specific method symbol via SymbolLocator
--to is the replacement method name (simple name; must exist on the same type as --from)
For each invocation of --from: replace only the member-access identifier (method name) with --to, leaving the expression, arguments, and trivia unchanged
If zero call sites found: print 'No calls to <from> found.' and exit 0
--dry-run shows unified diff across all changed files; no writes

userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Use SymbolFinder.FindReferencesAsync filtered to InvocationExpressionSyntax (same as FindCallersCommand). For each matching node replace MemberAccessExpressionSyntax.Name with SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName(toName).

userStories.title: Implement add-null-checks command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to add ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull guards for all non-nullable reference parameters.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt add-null-checks --type <ClassName> --method <MethodName> [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]
Alias: anc
Use SymbolLocator to find the method; error if not found
For each parameter: skip if IsValueType; skip if NullableAnnotation == Annotated (string? etc.); skip if method body already contains ThrowIfNull(<paramName>) or `if (<paramName> == null)` throw
Insert `ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(<paramName>);` statements at the top of the method body (before any existing statements), one per eligible param in declaration order
Add `using System;` if not already present (ArgumentNullException namespace)
--dry-run shows unified diff; no writes
ALL AddNullChecksTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Use DocumentEditor.InsertBefore on the first statement in the method body. Build ExpressionStatementSyntax for ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull via SyntaxFactory. Check existing statements with a simple string/syntax search for the param name in a throw/guard pattern.

Test: ConvertToRecord_ClassBecomesRecord — `class Point` declaration replaced with `record Point`
Test: ConvertToRecord_PositionalParams_GeneratedFromInitProps — init-only auto-properties X and Y become positional parameters in record primary constructor `record Point(int X, int Y)`

userStories.notes: Phase: RED. records require C# 9+ (net5+). Positional record: `record Point(int X, int Y)` — properties become constructor params. Only init-only auto-props map cleanly to positional params; mutable setters get a warning.

userStories.title: Implement convert-to-record command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to convert a data class to a C# record for value semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt convert-to-record --type <ClassName> [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]
Alias: ctr
Find the class symbol and its declaration; error if not found or if already a record
Collect init-only auto-properties (get; init;) — these become positional parameters
Build positional record declaration: `record ClassName(Type Prop1, Type Prop2)` using SyntaxFactory
Remove: the original property declarations that became positional params; any Equals(object), GetHashCode(), ==/!= operator overloads (records generate these)
Warn to stderr (do not error) if mutable auto-props (set;) exist — they remain as regular properties on the record
Retain all other members (methods, constructors, non-auto fields) verbatim
--dry-run shows unified diff; no writes
ALL ConvertToRecordTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Change ClassDeclarationSyntax to RecordDeclarationSyntax with SyntaxKind.RecordKeyword. Build ParameterListSyntax from init-only props. Use DocumentEditor to replace the entire class node. The conversion is best done as a single ReplaceNode on the class declaration.

userStories.title: Implement implement-interface command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to add stub implementations for all unimplemented interface members.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt implement-interface --type <ClassName> [--interface <IName>] [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]
Alias: ii
Find the type symbol; error if not found or not a class

Property stubs: get => throw new NotImplementedException(); and/or set => throw new NotImplementedException(); as appropriate
Add stubs to the class via DocumentEditor.InsertMembers

--dry-run shows unified diff; no writes

userStories.title: Implement circular-deps command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to detect circular namespace dependencies to enforce layering rules.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt circular-deps [--scope <prefix>] [--solution <path>]
Alias: cdeps
Read-only — no --dry-run needed
Build namespace dependency graph: for each document, determine its namespace; collect all using directives; edge: file-namespace -> used-namespace
--scope filters to namespaces matching the prefix (e.g. MyApp.Services only analyzes that subtree)
Run cycle detection using DFS with gray/black node coloring
For each cycle found: print the cycle path, e.g. 'MyApp.A -> MyApp.B -> MyApp.A'
If no cycles: print 'No circular namespace dependencies found.' and exit 0
Progress (per-project) to stderr; cycles to stdout
ALL CircularDepsTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Build Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> adjacency list. Using directives are in CompilationUnitSyntax.Usings and NamespaceDeclarationSyntax.Usings. DFS: white=unvisited, gray=in-stack, black=done. Report first cycle found per strongly-connected component.

userStories.title: Implement dependency-graph command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to output a type dependency graph as JSON or DOT for visualization and analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI: rt dependency-graph [--type <ClassName>] [--depth <n>] [--format json|dot] [--scope <prefix>] [--solution <path>]
Alias: depgraph
Read-only — no --dry-run needed
Without --type: graph all types in the solution (filtered by --scope if provided)
With --type: graph starting from that type, up to --depth levels (default: unlimited)
Edge sources: field types, method parameter types, method return types, base class, implemented interfaces
Exclude: system types (System.*, Microsoft.*) unless they are in the solution
JSON format: { "nodes": [{"id":"FQN","name":"ShortName","namespace":"..."}], "edges": [{"from":"FQN","to":"FQN"}] }
DOT format: digraph { "ShortName" -> "OtherName"; ... }
Default format: json
ALL DependencyGraphTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Walk INamedTypeSymbol members: fields (IFieldSymbol.Type), methods (IMethodSymbol params + return), bases (INamedTypeSymbol.BaseType), interfaces (INamedTypeSymbol.Interfaces). BFS from root type if --type + --depth specified. Filter non-solution types by checking if symbol.ContainingAssembly is in the solution's project assemblies.

userStories.title: Implement add-test command (GREEN)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to add xUnit test stubs to an existing test class, either by name or by generating from acceptance criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: BASELINE: dotnet test RoslynTools.sln -v minimal — all tests green
CLI (single mode): rt add-test --class <TestClassName> --name <MethodName> [--file <path>] [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]
CLI (AC mode): rt add-test --class <TestClassName> --acs <"AC1; AC2; ..."> [--nested-class <GroupName>] [--file <path>] [--solution <path>] [--dry-run]
Alias: at
--class locates the test class by name in the solution (or --file for direct file path)
Single mode: append one [Fact] public void <MethodName>() { throw new NotImplementedException(); } to the class

AC mode: split --acs on ';', trim whitespace, convert each AC to a valid C# identifier: strip punctuation, title-case each word, join with '_' (e.g. 'Returns null when not found' -> 'Returns_Null_When_Not_Found')
AC mode with --nested-class: wrap all generated test methods in a nested `public class <GroupName> { ... }` inside the target class
Add `using Xunit;` if not already present
Add `using System;` if not already present (NotImplementedException)
--dry-run shows unified diff; no writes
ALL AddTestTests go GREEN
ALL existing tests stay green
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes
userStories.notes: Phase: GREEN. Use DocumentEditor to append members to the class. AC->identifier: Regex.Replace(ac, "[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]", ""), split on whitespace, TextInfo.ToTitleCase each word, join with '_'. For nested class: build ClassDeclarationSyntax containing the generated [Fact] methods, then append that to the outer test class.
